veranderings.rede: 'Onkruid' is mostly used as a mass noun; 'n onkruidplant' names one plant more naturally.
'Vasklou' is the idiomatic verb for roots gripping the soil and avoids repeating 'hou ... vas' from the previous sentence.

veranderings.voor: Die wortels suig ook water uit die grond op vir die plant
veranderings.na: Die wortels suig ook water vir die plant uit die grond op
veranderings.rede: The separable particle 'op' belongs at the end of the clause, not before a trailing phrase.

veranderings.voor: Die blare van 'n plant maak met sonlig kos vir die hele plant
veranderings.na: Die blare van 'n plant gebruik sonlig om kos vir die hele plant te maak
veranderings.rede: The wedged-in 'met sonlig' reads woodenly; 'gebruik sonlig om ... te maak' is clearer for Grade 4 with the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: Die meeste blare is plat en wyd en vang so baie sonlig op
veranderings.na: Die meeste blare is plat en wyd, en so vang hulle baie sonlig op
veranderings.rede: Two 'en's in a row blur the sentence; giving the second clause its own subject makes it clear and takes the AWS comma.

veranderings.na: waar die plant nuwe sade maak
veranderings.rede: 'Sade begin' is vague and incomplete in Afrikaans; 'die plant nuwe sade maak' matches the wording used later in the lesson.

veranderings.voor: en ruik lekker en lok so insekte en voëls
veranderings.na: en ruik lekker, en so lok hulle insekte en voëls
veranderings.rede: A chain of three 'en's is hard to follow; a second clause with its own subject reads better and takes the AWS comma.

veranderings.voor: Dieselfde varing dra ook geen vrug en geen saad nie
veranderings.na: 'n Varing dra ook geen vrugte of sade nie
veranderings.rede: 'Dieselfde varing' points to a specific fern that was never introduced (the first block speaks of ferns in general), and 'geen vrugte of sade nie' is the natural negative.

veranderings.blok: Wat die vrug en die saad doen
veranderings.rede: 'Weg te help' is vague and unidiomatic; the next sentence shows the meaning is spreading the seeds, which 'versprei' says plainly (reviewer: check it is not a term other lessons word differently).

veranderings.blok: Wat die vrug en die saad doen
veranderings.voor: en los die sade ver weg
veranderings.na: en laat die sade ver weg agter
veranderings.rede: 'Los ... ver weg' is colloquial and unclear; 'laat ... agter' is the standard expression for leaving something behind.

vlae.teks: Die deel wat die plant regop hou en water boontoe dra.
vlae.rede: Read alone, the glossary entry says every stem holds the plant upright, while the study text says this only for most plants and that most ferns' stems lie underground; the language is fine, but fixing it would change content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
